headline: 3 Bank Stocks Worth Watching As Fed Rate Bets Shift
summary: Interest rate expectations are swinging again, with the Fed funds range at 3.75% to 4% and inflation still at 3.7%, so rate sensitive bank and insurance stocks are back under the spotlight. When policy direction feels uncertain, markets often reprice winners and laggards quickly, which can leave patient investors either rewarded or sidelined.
